import json, re, os, collections

TMP = os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/i022'
census = json.load(open(TMP+'/census_net.json'))
funcs = collections.defaultdict(list)
for p, name, start, op, ln in census:
    funcs[(p, name, start)].append((op, ln))

# Candidate callees: functions whose body contains a relocating op on a parameter skb.
# Extract callee signatures to see if they take struct sk_buff *skb (not const).
callees = {}
for (p, name, start), ops in funcs.items():
    try:
        text = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    lines = text.split('\n')
    # signature: up to 5 lines from start-1
    sig = '\n'.join(lines[start-1:start+4])
    # find param list
    m = re.search(r'\(([^;{}]*?)\)\s*$', sig, re.S)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\((.*)\)', sig, re.S)
    params = m.group(1) if m else ''
    has_skb_param = re.search(r'struct\s+sk_buff\s*\*', params)
    const_skb = re.search(r'const\s+struct\s+sk_buff\s*\*', params)
    if has_skb_param:
        callees[(p, name)] = {'start': start, 'ops': ops, 'params': ' '.join(params.split())[:180], 'const': bool(const_skb)}

print('callees with skb param:', len(callees))
# Now scan net/ and drivers/net for call sites of these callee names where
# the caller also has a live local pointer-into-skb captured before the call.
# Strategy: for each callee name (unique), find call sites in net/ and drivers/,
# then check the enclosing function for pointer captures before the call line.
cal_by_name = collections.defaultdict(list)

    cal_by_name[name].append((p, info))

callees = set(json.load(open(os.path.join(os.environ["TMPDIR"], "i022", "callees.json"))).keys())
# add multi-arg known pull-wrapper families by name pattern
pat = re.compile(r"^(ip_mc_may_pull|ipv6_mc_may_pull|lowpan_fetch_skb|.*_check_hdr|.*_hdr_ok|.*hdr_ok|.*_may_pull|.*_pull_skb|.*_pull_data|check_header|.*_pull_rcsum)$")
# capture forms: type *var = <expr with skb->data / *_hdr(skb) / skb_header_pointer>
CAP = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:const\s+)?(?:struct\s+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*\*\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*(?:skb->data|_hdr\(skb|skb_header_pointer|skb_network_header|skb_mac_header|skb_transport_header).*)")
# also value-capture style assignments to existing pointer vars
RECAP = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*(?:skb->data|_hdr\(skb\)|skb_header_pointer|skb_network_header\(skb\)|skb_transport_header\(skb\)|skb_mac_header\(skb\)).*);")

hits = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
    dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in (".git", "tools", "Documentation")]
    for fn in filenames:
        if not fn.endswith((".c", ".h")):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, ROOT)
        try:
            lines = open(p, errors="ignore").read().split("\n")
        except OSError:
            continue
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            for m in re.finditer(r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\(", line):
                name = m.group(1)
                if name not in callees and not pat.match(name):
                    continue
                # must look like a call, not a definition in this line
                if re.search(r"^\s*(static\s+)?(?:inline\s+)?[A-Za-z_].*\b" + name + r"\s*\($", line):
                    continue
                # search backward up to 60 lines for a capture of a pointer
                window = lines[max(0, i-60):i]
                for j, wl in enumerate(window[::-1]):
                    cm = CAP.match(wl) or RECAP.match(wl)
                    if cm:
                        var = cm.group(1)
                        # does var appear after the call line (next 40 lines) as deref?
                        post = lines[i+1:i+41]
                        for pl in post:
                            if re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(var) + r"\s*(->|\[|\.)", pl):
                                hits.append((rel, i+1, name, var, j, lines[i]))
                                break
                        break
seen = set()
out = []
for h in hits:
    key = (h[0], h[1])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    out.append(h)
for h in out:
    print(f"{h[0]}:{h[1]} call={h[2]} captured_var={h[3]} dist={h[4]}")
print("TOTAL", len(out))
PYEOF

import os, re, sys, json

ROOT = "."

# head-relocating call regex
RELOC = re.compile(r'\b(pskb_may_pull|pskb_pull|pskb_pull_reserve|__pskb_pull_tail|skb_linearize|__skb_linearize|skb_cow|skb_cow_head|pskb_expand_head|skb_unclone|skb_share_check|ip_mc_may_pull|ipv6_mc_may_pull|ip_mc_check_igmp|ipv6_mc_check_mld|skb_checksum_setup|skb_checksum_complete|l2tp_v3_ensure_opt_in_linear|__pskb_trim|pskb_trim|pskb_trim_rcsum|skb_linearize_rcsum)\s*\(')

CAPTURE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:const\s+)?(?:struct\s+)?[\w]+\s*\*\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(.+?);\s*$')

def func_spans(text):
    """Yield (start_line, end_line, name) for top-level function bodies by brace matching."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    n = len(lines)
    # find function definition starts: line ending with ')' followed by '{' possibly, at col 0
    i = 0
    funcs = []
    fname_re = re.compile(r'^(\w[\w\.\* ]*?)\s*\(([^;]*)$')
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        m = fname_re.match(line)
        if m and not line.startswith(("if","for","while","switch","return","} else","else")):
            # find the '{' at some following line, at column 0
            j = i
            depth = 0
            started = False
            name = m.group(1).split()[-1]
            while j < n and j < i + 8:
                if '{' in lines[j]:
                    started = True
                    break
                if lines[j].strip().endswith(';'):
                    break
                j += 1
            if started:
                # brace match from line j
                k = j
                while k < n:
                    depth += lines[k].count('{') - lines[k].count('}')
                    if depth == 0 and k >= j:
                        break
                    k += 1
                if k < n:
                    funcs.append((i, k, name))
                    i = k + 1
                    continue
        i += 1
    return funcs

def scan_file(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not RELOC.search(text):
        return None
    funcs = func_spans(text)
    lines = text.split("\n")
    callees = {}   # func name -> (path, start, end)
    for (s, e, name) in funcs:
        body = "\n".join(lines[s:e+1])
        if RELOC.search(body):
            callees.setdefault(name, (path, s+1, e+1))
    return text, lines, funcs, callees

all_funcs = {}   # file -> funcs list
all_callees = {}  # name -> list of (file, s, e)

count = 0
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(ROOT):
    # restrict to net/ and drivers/
    rel = os.path.relpath(root, ROOT)
    if not (rel.startswith("net") or rel.startswith("drivers")):
        dirs[:] = []
        continue
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git",)]
    for fn in files:
        if not fn.endswith((".c",)):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(root, fn)
        r = scan_file(p)
        if r is None:
            continue
        text, lines, funcs, callees = r
        all_funcs[p] = (text, lines, funcs)
        for name, (path, s, e) in callees.items():
            all_callees.setdefault(name, []).append((p, s, e))
        count += 1

print(f"scanned {count} files with reloc calls; {len(all_callees)} distinct callee names", file=sys.stderr)

# Now find caller sites: a capture of a header pointer, then a call to a callee name within the same function
CALL = re.compile(r'\b(\w+)\s*\(')
HDRVAR_HINT = re.compile(r'(hdr|iph|ip6h|th|uh|tcph|udph|greh|guehdr|ga|grec|ph|tf|opth|exthdr|nskb|fr|mh|sh|hdr2|p|data|ptr|optr|cursor|buf|payload|opt|tlv|fh|cih|icmph|icmp|mgmt|wh|eh|vh|rh|gh|nvhdr|nshh|sph|psph|ppph|po|ppp)')

results = []
callee_names = set(all_callees.keys())

for p, (text, lines, funcs) in all_funcs.items():
    for (s, e, name) in funcs:
        body_lines = lines[s:e+1]
        # captures: line index (absolute) -> var
        captures = []
        for idx, ln in enumerate(body_lines):
            m = CAPTURE.match(ln)
            if m:
                var, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
                if re.search(r'(skb->data|skb_header_pointer|skb_network_header|skb_transport_header|skb_mac_header|_hdr\(skb\)|mpls_hdr|skb_tail_pointer|skb_shinfo\(skb\)->frags)', rhs):
                    captures.append((s+idx+1, var, rhs.strip()))
        if not captures:
            continue
        # calls to callee names
        calls = []
        for idx, ln in enumerate(body_lines):
            for m in CALL.finditer(ln):
                cn = m.group(1)
                if cn in callee_names and cn != name:
                    col = m.start()
                    calls.append((s+idx+1, cn, col, ln.strip()))
        if not calls:
            continue
        # for each call, find captures strictly before it in the function and dereferences after
        for (cl, cn, col, cltext) in calls:
            for (capline, var, rhs) in captures:
                if capline < cl:
                    # check if var is used after the call line
                    used_after = False
                    use_lines = []
                    for idx2 in range(cl - s - 1, len(body_lines)):
                        ln2 = body_lines[idx2]
                        if f"{var}->" in ln2 or f"{var}[" in ln2 or f"*{var}" in ln2 or f"({var})" in ln2 or f" {var})," in ln2 or f",{var})" in ln2 or f" {var};" in ln2 or f"= {var};" in ln2:
                            # skip the call line itself for the pointer being passed as arg (that's pre-call eval, fine)
                            if (s+idx2+1) == cl:
                                continue
                            used_after = True
                            use_lines.append((s+idx2+1, ln2.strip()))
                    if used_after and len(use_lines) <= 40:
                        results.append({
                            "file": p,
                            "caller": name,
                            "caller_span": [s+1, e+1],
                            "capture": {"line": capline, "var": var, "rhs": rhs},
                            "callee": cn,
                            "call_line": cl,
                            "call_text": cltext,
                            "post_uses": use_lines[:12],
                        })

# dedupe
seen = set()
out = []
for r in results:
    key = (r["file"], r["caller"], r["capture"]["var"], r["callee"], r["call_line"])
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    out.append(r)

out.sort(key=lambda r: (len(r["post_uses"]), r["file"]))
with open(os.path.join(os.environ.get("TMPDIR","/tmp"), "i022", "pairs.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=1)
print(f"{len(out)} candidate caller chains", file=sys.stderr)
for r in out[:80]:
    print(f"{r['file']}:{r['call_line']} caller={r['caller']} callee={r['callee']} cap={r['capture']['var']}@{r['capture']['line']} uses_after={len(r['post_uses'])}")
PYEOF

import os, re, sys, json

ROOT = "."

# restrict to net/ and drivers/ .c/.h files
files = []
for base in ["net", "drivers"]:
    for dirpath, dirs, fnames in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT, base)):
        for f in fnames:
            if f.endswith((".c", ".h")):
                files.append(os.path.join(dirpath, f))

# relocating call regexes
RELOC = re.compile(r'\b(pskb_may_pull|pskb_pull|pskb_pull_reserve|__pskb_pull_tail|skb_linearize|__skb_linearize|skb_cow|skb_cow_head|skb_unclone|pskb_expand_head|skb_share_check|skb_linearize_cow|skb_cow_data|ip_mc_may_pull|ipv6_mc_may_pull)\s*\(')

# capture regex: pointer into skb head/data. Broad forms:
#  type *var = skb->data; / (cast)skb->data
#  type *var = <something>_hdr(skb);
#  type *var = skb_header_pointer(...);
CAPTURE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:const\s+)?struct\s+\w+\s*\*\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*([^;]+);')
CAPTURE2 = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:const\s+)?\w+\s*\*\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(?:\([^)]*\)\s*)?(skb->data|skb_network_header\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)|skb_mac_header\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)|skb_transport_header\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)|skb_tail_pointer\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)|skb_header_pointer\s*\([^;]*)\s*;')
HDRASSIGN = re.compile(r'^\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(?:\([^)]*\)\s*)?(?:skb|[^;]*->skb|[^;]*skb)\s*->\s*data\s*;')

FUNC_RE = re.compile(r'^(\w[\w\s\*]*?)\b(\w+)\s*\([^;]*\)\s*$')

def func_spans(text):
    """yield (startline, endline, name) for top-level function bodies"""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        m = re.match(r'^(\w[\w \t\*]*?)\b(\w+)\s*\(', line)
        if m and not line.strip().endswith(";") and "=" not in line.split("(")[0]:
            # find opening brace
            j = i
            depth = 0
            started = False
            while j < n:
                for ch in lines[j]:
                    if ch == "{":
                        depth += 1
                        started = True
                    elif ch == "}":
                        depth -= 1
                        if started and depth == 0:
                            yield (i, j, m.group(2))
                            i = j + 1
                            break
                if started and depth <= 0:
                    break
                j += 1
            i = j + 1
            continue
        i += 1

pairs = []
callers_with_capture = []
for path in files:
    try:
        text = open(path, errors="ignore").read()
    except Exception:
        continue
    for (s, e, fname) in func_spans(text):
        body = "\n".join(text.split("\n")[s:e+1])
        if not RELOC.search(body):
            continue
        # this function is a "callee" that relocates
        pairs.append((path, fname, s+1, e+1))

json.dump(pairs, open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "callees.json", "w"))
